metrics.label: Feasible plans
metrics.note: A plan that breaks a hard constraint is a correctness failure.

metrics.label: Unit coverage
metrics.note: Adds units of different resources; read with mean_resource_coverage.

metrics.label: Critical-zone coverage
metrics.note: Defined by the same fuzzy scores AidOS uses.

metrics.label: Starved zones
metrics.note: Zones with positive demand that receive nothing.

metrics.label: Jain index of zone coverage
metrics.note: Equality of coverage, not humanitarian fairness.

metrics.label: Policy runtime (median of repeats)
metrics.note: Wall clock on one machine; varies between runs.

A.name: Low scarcity
A.description: Stock is 85-110% of requests per resource.

B.name: Moderate scarcity
B.description: Stock is 60-85% of requests per resource.

C.name: Severe scarcity
C.description: Stock is 25-50% of requests per resource.

D.name: Unequal urgency
D.description: Half the zones are rated 7-10 on every input, half 0-3; stock 50-80%.

E.name: Equal or near-equal urgency
E.description: All zones share one rating triple (even seeds) or differ by at most 1 point per input (odd seeds); stock 50-80%.

F.name: Unequal demand
F.description: One or two zones request 4-8 times more than the others; stock 50-80%.

G.name: Multiple resource shortages
G.description: Four resources: three are short (30-60%), one is ample (100-130%).
